b1-allampolgarsag-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Becoming a Citizen by Birth
b1-allampolgarsag-01.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks how a child becomes a Hungarian citizen.
b1-allampolgarsag-01.prompt: Tell the official when a child becomes a Hungarian citizen at birth and whether dual citizenship is recognised.
cues: Say what the parents must be
Say whether dual citizenship is recognised
b1-allampolgarsag-01.target: A gyermek születésével magyar állampolgár lesz, ha legalább az egyik szülője magyar állampolgár. A magyar jog elismeri a kettős állampolgárságot.
b1-allampolgarsag-01.english: A child becomes a Hungarian citizen at birth if at least one parent is a Hungarian citizen. Hungarian law recognises dual citizenship.
b1-allampolgarsag-01.canDo: I can explain how Hungarian citizenship is acquired by birth (jus sanguinis) and naturalization.

b1-allampolgarsag-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Voting and Petitions
b1-allampolgarsag-02.scenario: At a museum exhibition about democracy, the guide asks you about the rights of Hungarian citizens.
b1-allampolgarsag-02.prompt: Tell the guide who has the right to vote and where a citizen can turn with a request.
cues: Say where a request can be sent
b1-allampolgarsag-02.target: Minden nagykorú magyar állampolgárnak joga van szavazni. Kérelemmel vagy panasszal fordulhatnak a hatóságokhoz.
b1-allampolgarsag-02.english: Every adult Hungarian citizen has the right to vote. They can turn to the authorities with a request or a complaint.
b1-allampolgarsag-02.canDo: I can articulate fundamental constitutional rights (voting, petition, peaceful assembly).

b1-allampolgarsag-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Duties of a Citizen
b1-allampolgarsag-03.scenario: A Hungarian teacher is preparing you for the citizenship interview and asks about citizens' duties.
b1-allampolgarsag-03.prompt: Tell the teacher what everyone must pay and whose duty it is to protect the environment.
cues: Say what everyone pays according to income
Say who must protect the environment
b1-allampolgarsag-03.target: Mindenki a jövedelme szerint köteles adót fizetni. A környezetvédelem az állam és mindenki kötelessége.
b1-allampolgarsag-03.english: Everyone must pay tax according to their income. Environmental protection is the duty of the state and of everyone.
b1-allampolgarsag-03.canDo: I can explain constitutional duties: public taxation (közteherviselés), defense, and schooling.

b1-allampolgarsag-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Citizenship Ceremony
b1-allampolgarsag-04.scenario: At your citizenship interview, the official asks what happens at the end of the procedure.
b1-allampolgarsag-04.prompt: Tell the official where the oath can be taken and what the oath-taker receives.
cues: Say where the oath can be taken
Say what the new citizen receives
b1-allampolgarsag-04.target: Az esküt a polgármester előtt lehet letenni, külföldön a külképviseleten. Az új állampolgárok átveszik a honosítási okiratot.
b1-allampolgarsag-04.english: The oath can be taken before the mayor, and abroad at a diplomatic mission. The new citizens receive the naturalisation document.
b1-allampolgarsag-04.canDo: I can say what the citizenship oath and pledge are and where they are taken.

b1-allampolgarsag-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The Citizenship Exam
b1-allampolgarsag-05.scenario: A Hungarian teacher asks you what the constitutional basics exam is like.
b1-allampolgarsag-05.prompt: Tell the teacher what language the exam is in and what you studied for it.
cues: Say what language the exam is in
b1-allampolgarsag-05.target: A vizsgát magyarul kell letenni. Az Alaptörvényt és az államszervezetet tanultam.
b1-allampolgarsag-05.english: The exam has to be taken in Hungarian. I studied the Fundamental Law and the state organisation.
b1-allampolgarsag-05.canDo: I can say what the constitutional basics exam covers and that it is taken in Hungarian.

b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Citizenship Interview
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.scenario: In a practice interview, the official asks what you have learnt about being a Hungarian citizen.
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official one right and one duty of a Hungarian citizen.
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.target: Minden nagykorú magyar állampolgárnak joga van szavazni. Mindenki köteles a jövedelme szerint adót fizetni.
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.english: Every adult Hungarian citizen has the right to vote. Everyone must pay tax according to their income.
b1-allampolgarsag-consolidation.canDo: I can say how Hungarian citizenship is acquired, which rights and duties citizens have, and what the oath is.
